properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Front Door: Require TLS 1.2 Minimum
properties.description: Denies Azure Front Door custom domain configurations that do not enforce TLS 1.2 as the minimum version. FedRAMP High requires transmission confidentiality (SC-8) and FIPS-validated cryptographic mechanisms (SC-13). TLS 1.0 and 1.1 have known vulnerabilities and are prohibited in FedRAMP High environments.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Front Door custom domain creation with TLS version below 1.2. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
